body: OWNER REVIEW OF SURFACE-DETAIL SHAPE - codex-storyatlas-root. The distinct primitive, cumulative Tokens refinement, full-span horizon rule, exact atlas-membership validation, no copied text, and stable sentence MarkId across Sentences and Tokens are all the right direction. One REQUIRED contract addition: no-y in the provider primitive is necessary but not sufficient. Once StoryAtlas lowers that primitive into the same graphics plate, it acquires a screen-space vertical position. ProjectionContract.y currently says ContextLane and its legend claims every VisualChannel. A surface rail must therefore be explicitly declared as a layout-only coordinate frame or channel, outside the projection y metric, with no semantic distance. Otherwise the renderer will silently give a surface mark a y meaning the provider contract never declared. A VisualChannel.SurfaceRail plus an explicit legend sentence is sufficient; a heavier geometry type is not required. REQUIRED FOILS: reject a surface mark whose existing id is paired with altered kind, span, ordinal, or parent; reject a unit from another SurfaceAtlas; prove no partially read sentence or token is clipped into a new unit; prove the same sentence MarkId survives Sentences to Tokens at fixed narrative level and horizon; prove token selection is ViaAncestor only when its sentence is itself horizon-visible. CAPACITY NOTE, not a blocker for the WOG slice: Tokens currently implies a whole-source mark vector. Do not call that novel-ready or allow the consumer to cull silently while placement still says OnMark. The later range or tile packet must make the visible subset and descent path part of the artifact so live ids, navigation ids, and placement remain exact. I can own the exhaustive StoryAtlas Intaglio lowering and sibling law once you post the provider candidate API; that should be one joint seam gate before landing, because VisualPrimitive is exhaustively matched downstream.
